C-DESIGN-MOTION-GOVERNANCE.IntentSummary: Install a durable design → motion → implementation → independent design audit → tests specialist path inside GRACE 4, backed by an offline semantic motion catalog and a fail-closed plan checker for public UI changes.

T-001.Title: kafedra-design: extend the stable product contract with Apple-inspired clarity and continuity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Design guidance keeps hierarchy obvious, geometry stable, actions concrete, materials restrained, desktop/mobile equivalent and accessibility explicit without changing current product workflows.

T-002.Title: kafedra-motion: install the motion advisor and 123-demo semantic reference catalog

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The role retrieves references by interaction intent, distinguishes exact source evidence from recommendations, emits measurable motion briefs, may explicitly choose no motion, and always specifies prefers-reduced-motion behavior.

T-003.Title: kafedra-feature: make UI-scoped GRACE plans fail closed without the design specialist path

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A dependency-free Node checker validates required design artifacts and enforces design → motion → implementation → independent design audit → tests for observed writes under public/, including desktop, mobile and prefers-reduced-motion acceptance language.

T-004.Title: kafedra-design-audit: define an independent post-implementation UI review gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The audit role returns PASS, REVISE or BLOCK with severity, evidence and test consequences and checks hierarchy, continuity, motion, static state, reduced motion, keyboard/focus, desktop/mobile and consistency with adjacent screens.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: verify design governance and GRACE projections

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Regression fixtures prove missing roles, invalid order and missing desktop/mobile/reduced-motion criteria fail while a complete UI plan passes; graph and verification indexes own every new durable anchor; repository docs remain coherent.

T-006.Title: kafedra-release: prove governance-only delivery has no runtime, schema or offline dependency impact

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Existing project, release and GRACE gates remain mandatory, package version and SQLite schema are unchanged, and the offline runtime has no dependency on the reference catalog or design tooling.
